activation.subject: {{websiteName}} — Activate your e-mail
activation.activation-text: Please activate your e-mail by clicking the button below to get started:
activation.activation-code-instruction: Or, copy and paste this activation code:
activation.activation-expires: This activation link will expire in {{minutes}} minutes. If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.
activation.support-contact: If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

banned.subject: {{websiteName}} — Your account has been banned!
banned.banned-notice: We are writing to inform you that your account has been banned.
banned.banned-support: If you have any questions or concerns, please contact our support team.

change-email.subject: {{websiteName}} — Confirm your new email address
change-email.change-email-request: You have requested to change your email address to:
change-email.confirm-change-instruction: Please confirm this change by clicking the button below:
change-email.change-email-expires: This confirmation link will expire in {{minutes}} minutes. If you didn't request this change, please ignore this email and consider securing your account.
change-email.support-contact: If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

password-updated.subject: {{websiteName}} — Your password has been updated
password-updated.password-updated-confirmation: Your password has been successfully updated. Your account is now secure with your new password.
password-updated.password-security-tip: If you didn't make this change, please contact our support team immediately and secure your account.
password-updated.password-updated-support: If you have any questions or concerns about this password change, please contact our support team.
password-updated.support-contact: If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

reset-password.subject: {{websiteName}} — Reset your password
reset-password.reset-password-request: We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to create a new password:
reset-password.reset-password-code-instruction: Or, copy and paste this reset code:
reset-password.reset-password-expires: This password reset link will expire in {{minutes}} minutes.
reset-password.reset-password-ignore: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.
reset-password.reset-password-security: For security reasons, if you didn't request this password reset, we recommend that you review your account security settings.
reset-password.support-contact: If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

login.subject: {{websiteName}} — New login detected
login.suspicious-login-notice: We detected a login to your account that appears suspicious.
login.new-login-notice: We detected a new login to your account.
login.security-alert-instruction: If this wasn't you, please secure your account immediately by changing your password and enabling two-factor authentication.
login.login-ignore: If this was you, you can safely ignore this email. If you don't recognize this activity, please contact our support team immediately.
login.security-support: For security concerns, please contact our support team immediately.

register-success.subject: {{websiteName}} — Welcome to our community!
register-success.register-success: Your account has been successfully created. We're excited to have you on board!
register-success.register-success-instruction: You can now log in to your account and start exploring all the features we have to offer.
register-success.join-community: Join our community and start your adventure today!
register-success.register-support: If you have any questions or need help getting started, don't hesitate to contact our support team.
register-success.see-you-ingame: We're excited to have you on board. See you in-game!

maintenance.default-message: The site is temporarily unavailable while we carry out maintenance. Please check back in a little while.

notice.ip-banned: Too many failed sign-in attempts. This IP address has been blocked. Contact the site owner to regain access.
notice.no-access: You are signed in, but your account is not allowed to skip maintenance mode.
notice.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
notice.csrf: This request could not be verified. Please reload the page and try again.
notice.theme-switching: The site theme is being switched right now. Please try again in a moment.

maintenance.skip-description: You are signed in and allowed to browse the site during maintenance.
